name: Layout probe
description: Window check fixture that reports its tab reports, start values, surface size and a document region, opens .lprobe files, and declares sections, settings and a right sidebar override.

shade.label: Shade
shade.description: A choice that the probe reports.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: A bounded number that the probe reports.

caption.label: Caption
caption.description: A text that the probe reports.

status.name: layoutprobe.view
status.description: The start values of the tab view (surface, params, path, origin, project and the directory it starts in), the plugin settings, and the title, footer, directory and notice it reported.

status.name: layoutprobe.surface
status.description: The size and scale of the tab view, the rectangle of its document region in the view, its document visibility and its theme.

status.name: layoutprobe.document
status.description: The document of the region: its address, whether it reported, its color scheme, its visibility (shown, hidden or occluded), its visibilitychange count since it loaded, its stored site data value and its content color.

status.name: layoutprobe.section
status.description: A section view of the probe: its section, sidebar and card, its size, whether its document overflows it, the surface that core.sidebars reports for it, and the layoutprobe.view of that surface for the follow section.

commands.name: layoutprobe.title
commands.description: Sets the title of the tab with tab.title, or removes it with null.

commands.name: layoutprobe.footer
commands.description: Sets the footer text of the tab with tab.footer, or removes it with null.

commands.name: layoutprobe.notify
commands.description: Gives the tab a notice with tab.notify and the policy tab or system.

commands.name: layoutprobe.directory
commands.description: Records the working directory of the tab with tab.directory, or removes it with null.

commands.name: layoutprobe.document.color
commands.description: Paints the content of the region document in a CSS color.

commands.name: layoutprobe.open
commands.description: Runs core.file.open with the path from the view and answers the opened tab, or the failure message without failing.

commands.name: layoutprobe.document.store
commands.description: Writes a value into the local storage of the region document under the key of this tab.
